 Rewards! November Live Trading Streak Challenge: Win Up Yo 50,000 Points* 172K Views · 462 Posts Justieens Ong joined discussion · Oct 31 10:10 SpaceX Trade
 Live Trading Check In Day 6 SpaceX faces significant selling pressure, creating potential buying opportunities following its recent correction. Suggested Entry Strategy: - First Entry: $130–$135, if support holds. - Second Entry: $120–$125, on further weakness. - Strong Support: $105–$110. - Resistance: $145–$150. - Upside Targets: $160, followed by $170. - Stop Loss: Below $120 for a $130–$135 entry. My Evaluation: Avoid entering aggressively during the selloff. Wait for bullish reversal confirmation, ideally accompanied by stronger trading volume. SpaceX offers long-term growth exposure through Starlink, reusable rockets, and AI. However, high valuation, continued losses, and volatility remain major risks. Preferred Approach: Gradual accumulation rather than a full-position entry. Disclaimer: Community is offered by Moomoo Technologies Inc. and is for educational purposes only.
